common_contract.coverage: Full valid single-raw-contract minute coverage for every required formation/conditioning/target window. Missing first, interior or last minute, invalid row or raw-contract transition is unavailable/censored, never successful non-contact or a zero observation.
common_contract.denominators: Retain all eligible attempts and separate unavailable formation, censored future, no event, ambiguity, zero-width/displacement and matured event counts. Conditional rates identify exact conditioning support; no future-selected denominator.
common_contract.known_at: Formation geometry known=max(last formation bar known_at, formation end, actual calendar/source revision known_at). Conditioning final state known=max(all conditioning bar known_at, conditioning end, dependencies). Anchor open is known_at of its containing observed minute unless a separate actual open receipt exists. With bar_end_plus_60s, an 08:00 minute open is not available until08:02.
common_contract.literal_case_time_scope: Price-path lists are deliberately small local mechanism examples with stated complete coverage over their listed test horizon; actual source-clock formation/check duration remains in clock_recipes and requires all real constituent minutes. They do not assert two bars reproduce a four-hour source window.
common_contract.ohlc_evidence: A bar straddle low<=level<=high is source-compatible reach, not proof an interior tick was printed. O/H/L/C equality supplies definite level print. For fractional non-tick levels, exact print may be impossible although a barrier inequality can be reached. Cross-bar gaps never prove contact. Competing events within a bar require possible-order sets unless endpoints establish the order.
common_contract.price_domain: Integer ticks, exact rational target levels. No floating comparison tolerance or rounded replacement of fractional levels.
common_contract.provenance: Source code behavior, source hypothesis and newly specified study comparator are separate labels. Frozen source percentages/time tables are unverified historical claims, not observations.
common_contract.retrospective_vs_actionable: Nominal source horizon and observations before the full input known_at may be retained as retrospective descriptions with explicit flag. A decision-relative comparator must use an independently versioned origin at/after full input availability. Do not silently delete early source outcomes or claim their rates were actionable at nominal origin.
common_contract.time_evidence: OHLC event timestamps are bar intervals; O can establish origin boundary event, C can establish end event, interior high/low timing remains interval-censored. Exact intraminute latency is unavailable.
